r3-evidence.imperative: Recompute digest; reproduce focused, installer, G1/G2/init suites; parse JSON; run git diff --check; verify exact-one audit and Windows JSON rewriting. Record pass/fail.
r3-evidence.finding: Digest exact. Focused: 36 passed, 6 subtests; installer: 108 passed, 379 subtests; G1/G2/init: 62 passed, 59 subtests. Three spines parse; scoped and full git diff --check exit 0. Fresh installed probe proves exact-one audit and Windows JSON-safe executable rewriting. r4-quality.title: Quality vs inherited rules
r4-quality.imperative: Inspect pure-helper wiring, fail-fast strict inputs, dual rendering, Explorer/Commander artifact checks, and distinguish pre-existing drift. Record pass/fail.
r4-quality.finding: [P1] scripts/verify_iterative_role_artifacts.py admiral-prelaunch accepts applicable repair and returns 0 for NEXT_WAVE. Fresh installed probe uses launch_id=wave-2 and a valid repair packet, observed PASS admiral applicable repair authorizes. Shipped Admiral doctrine says repair holds current wave/forecast and no next launch occurs until blocking evidence is settled; no settled-evidence field/check exists. Generic G2 correctly validates/renders repair, but prelaunch must refuse it like stop.

r5-reconciliation.title: Reconciliation check
r5-reconciliation.imperative: Verify Map Impact and architecture/docs reconciliation claims against the diff and evidence. Record pass/fail and triage candidates.
r5-reconciliation.finding: No architecture map exists, so direct interface reconciliation applies. Structural installed seams and role artifacts match the diff. Capability/authority Map Impact overstates next-launch safety: it reports repair preservation but does not disclose that admiral-prelaunch authorizes NEXT_WAVE on repair despite doctrine requiring a hold. Rework belongs in G3; no out-of-scope triage candidate.

r6-fowler.finding: All 12 baseline smells visited and verifier exited 0. No Fowler-specific defect. Logged standards-based overrides cover intentional role prose/directive mirroring, strict JSON primitives, and finite three-role wiring around one shared helper.

r4a-repair-authority.finding: [P1] Fresh installed matrix confirms generic G2 validates/renders repair as required, but admiral-prelaunch returns 0 for the same repair with NEXT_WAVE launch_id=wave-2.
